name: Gallery Fake
source: Gallery Fake is a pure adventure game that takes after the anime/manga of the same name. You play as Fujita Reiji and must solve the mysterious events surrounding a few priceless pieces of artwork. Gameplay seems to be centered on dialogue, giving you options to "break" into conversations and determine when you're being told something that's "fake." New scenarios featuring famous real pieces of artwork will feature in this portable adaptation
